title: Verification of Predictive Biomarkers for Pancreatic Cancer Treatment Using Multicenter Liquid Biopsy
brief_summary: This study is for verification of predictive biomarkers for pancreatic cancer treatment using multi-center liquid biopsy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with pathologically confirmed pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients disagree with the study.
